newsitem.title: USA: Shared Technologies in sale/merger talks.
newsitem.headline: Shared Technologies in sale/merger talks.

text.p: Shared Technologies Fairchild Inc said on Monday that it is having discussions with an unnamed party regarding the possible sale or merger of the company.

Shared Technologies said in a news release that it issued this statement in response to recent trading activity in its stock. The company said there were no assurances that the discussions would result in a definitive agreement for a merger or a sale.
The company provides shared telecommunications services and systems. Its shares were up 3/8 to 9-3/8 in early Nasdaq trading.
